sloka: तूष्णीम्भूते तदा तस्मिन्राजा दशरथो मुनौ ।अभिवाद्य महात्मानौ पुनरायात्पुरोत्तमम् ।। ७.५१.२८ ॥
transliteration: tūṣṇīmbhūte tadā tasminrājā daśaratho munau ।abhivādya mahātmānau punarāyātpurottamam ।। 7.51.28 ॥

translations.english: This word, spoken by the sage there formerly, was heard by me and placed in my heart, and it will not be otherwise.
